steps.title: Grind Tissue Sample
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt the tissue sample using one of two methods.

substeps.instruction: Method 1: Place tissue sample and a 6 mm glass ball in an Eppendorf Safe-Lock microcentrifuge tube, freeze at -80°C, and grind in the MM300 Mixer Mill for 2 min at 30 Hz.
Method 2: Grind the sample directly in the lysis solution, ensuring sufficient empty space remains in the tube.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Lysis of the disrupted tissue or DNA solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml CTAB solution buffer with RNAse A to a 2 ml tube containing the disrupted tissue/seeds/leaves/herbarium or DNA solution (ensure sample mass does not exceed 100 mg).
Incubate samples at 55-65°C for 30-120 min or longer.

steps.title: Clarify Supernatant
steps.instruction: Optionally clarify the lysate before proceeding.

substeps.instruction: Spin at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge for 2 minutes.
Transfer the entire clarified supernatant to a new 2 ml Safe-Lock microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Separate DNA from proteins and lipids using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform to the clarified supernatant in a 2 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Mix well for 3-5 minutes (or 1-5 minutes) in the MM300 Mixer Mill at 30 Hz, or vortex thoroughly for 1 minute.
Spin at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge for 1-3 minutes.
Transfer the entire clarified upper aqueous layer to a new 2 ml microcentrifuge tube containing half to an equal volume of 2-propanol.
Centrifuge at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge for 2-5 minutes until a whitish DNA pellet is visible.

steps.title: Wash DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the precipitated DNA pellet to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5-1.8 ml 70% ethanol to the pellet and vortex thoroughly.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 2 min.
Carefully discard the supernatant by decanting or with a micropipette.

steps.title: Dissolve DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in buffer.

substeps.instruction: Do not dry the DNA pellet.
Immediately dissolve the pellet in 300 μl 1xTE, pH 8.0 at 55°C for 10-20 minutes.
